title: Hi there and welcome!
text:
Hey it’s a pleasure, I’m Kevin, an Economics student interested in research, data, and applied economics.
I use this website to document what I learn and the projects I work on throughout my studies. Here you will find economic analyses, data visualizations, essays, and research projects covering a variety of topics.
I am still exploring where my interests in economics will take me, so I am keeping an open mind and learning by doing.
Explore my work, or learn more about me.
For now, I’m focused on studying economics through my remaining semesters. Most of my posts will be in Spanish, with the occasional one in English. Feel free to explore some of my coding endeavors on GitHub, follow me on Twitter/X.

Kevin Martínez is a sixth-semester Economics student at Universidad Santiago de Cali. He is interested in economic research and enjoys learning about how economic ideas and data can be used to understand real-world problems. Although he has not yet decided which area of research he wants to pursue, he is keeping an open mind and exploring different fields of economics.
Kevin’s long-term goal is to work at the central bank of his country, where he hopes to contribute to economic research and analysis. He believes that research plays an important role in human progress and that new ideas should always be built upon the knowledge and evidence that came before them.

Education
Universidad Santiago de Cali | Cali, Colombia Economics | Currently in 6th semester


Current Focus

Economic Research Developing skills in economic analysis, research methods, and causal analysis.
Data & Programming Building proficiency in Python and learning to use data to investigate economic questions.
Applied Economics Exploring different areas of economics through projects, essays, data analysis, and visualization.
